articles.title: Olive Oil's Dark Side? Fat Type, Not Amount, Drives Pancreatic Cancer in Mice
articles.summary: A Yale study found oleic acid—the main fat in olive oil—sped up pancreatic tumor growth in mice, while omega-3s from fish oil suppressed it. The type of fat, not total fat, was key.

articles.title: Brain Scans Reveal How Expert Echolocators Build Mental Maps Click by Click
articles.summary: A new study shows blind echolocation experts combine echoes over time to pinpoint objects. Their brains integrate each click-echo pair, improving accuracy with every sound.

articles.title: Winds at 15,000 MPH Reveal First Exoplanet Magnetic Fields—Key to Finding Alien Life
articles.summary: By clocking winds up to 15,530 mph on seven hot Jupiters, astronomers made the first direct measurement of exoplanet magnetic fields. The fields act as brakes, and could shield potential life.
